headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: New York reports first measles death in more than 30 years
headlines.description: So far this year, the state has reported 178 measles cases.

headlines.title: NBC News producer shares personal journey battling Alzheimer’s
headlines.description: Senior Coordinating Producer Sue Kroll travels the world covering the news, but tonight she shares her own story about her battle to fend off Alzheimer’s and the steps she’s taking to avoid the brutal disease. NBC News’ Senior National Correspondent Kate Snow reports Sue’s story.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Murphy hospitalized after suffering stroke
headlines.description: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., is recovering after having a stroke on Saturday. According to his chief of staff, Murphy started experiencing numbness in his arm while at his son's hockey game. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar explains what causes strokes, typical warning signs and treatment.

headlines.title: Study links energy drinks to risk of cardiac arrest
headlines.description: New research presented at the American Heart Association’s annual meeting found that cardiac arrest was higher among those who consumed energy drinks and supplements. NBC News’ Berkeley Lovelace Jr. explains which types of stimulants to watch out for.

headlines.title: Get Your Steps in This Fall With Start TODAY’s November Plan
headlines.description: Kick off November with Start TODAY’s plan for building a walking streak over the next 75 days. Fitness contributor Stephanie Mansour and nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer serve up motivation and healthy recipes to help you reach your goal.

headlines.title: Allergies acting up? You may need a humidifier.
headlines.description: Find the best humidifiers to relieve allergies and dry skin. Shop humidifiers from brands like Honeywell, Levoit, Vicks and more.

headlines.title: 37 creative cooking gifts that will make anyone excited about being in the kitchen
headlines.description: I found the best gifts for people who love to cook, including cookware, gadgets, and edible gifts from an array of brands, even favorites, like Le Creuset, Williams Sonoma, Staub and more.

headlines.title: Michaels, Home Depot and Birch Lane all have Christmas trees on sale this week for up to 50% off
headlines.description: Retailers are already discounting prelit Christmas trees for the holidays — save up to 50% on trees from Home Depot, Michael’s, Birch Lane and more.

headlines.title: How to insulate your home to keep it warm during the winter, according to experts
headlines.description: I spoke to multiple home experts to learn how to keep your home warm and insulated when the temperature drops, and the best hands-on tools to use.

headlines.title: Dietitian Reveals the Healthiest Type of Canned Tuna
headlines.description: Canned tuna is a quick source of protein, but which type is best for you? A dietitian reveals what to look for in healthier canned tuna and which types to limit.

headlines.title: Dietitian Shares Her Favorite High-Protein Food to Balance Blood Sugar
headlines.description: You can use food to manage blood sugar spikes and keep your energy steady throughout the day. A dietitian recommends one high-protein and high-fiber food to help.
